description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS application demonstrating usage of zbus messaging system, including channel definitions, validators, listeners, subscribers, and main execution logic.

methods.name: simple_chan_validator
methods.description: Validates that the message is an integer between 0 and 9.

methods.name: listener_callback_example
methods.description: Callback function invoked when the listener receives a message, logs accelerometer data.

methods.name: subscriber_task
methods.description: Task that waits for messages on bar_sub and reads accelerometer data from acc_data_chan.

methods.name: print_channel_data_iterator
methods.description: Iterates over channels, logs their name, message size, and observers.

methods.name: print_observer_data_iterator
methods.description: Iterates over observers, logs their type and name.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing and demonstrating zbus channels, observers, and message publishing.
